lessons: Ticket premise is false: `snapshot` must read `Ticket.scope_fence` (a required field, clutch/tickets.py:104), but snapshot test stand-ins built without it break existing suites. The ticket must fence those files, and its scope currently forbids editing tests/integration/test_watch.py.

Re-scope the fence to add tests/unit/test_menu_admission.py, tests/unit/test_snapshot_merged_cap.py, tests/unit/test_verdict_menu_parity.py, tests/integration/test_stale_running.py and tests/integration/test_watch.py. Only add `scope_fence=()` to their ticket stand-ins.

Remove the Scope in clause 'not editing that file or test_watch.py'. test_watch.py line 284 has stand-ins that need scope_fence (6 failures), so the fixture edit is forced. The no-new-tests-in-hot-files rule still applies: put new tests only in the two new files.

Do not add a getattr fallback for missing scope_fence in clutch/observe.py. It is a dual path for test doubles that CLAUDE.md 'No dual-path code' forbids. The attempt correctly rejected it as a dead end.

The rest of the approach was sound and passed the focused Verification: a private builder in observe.py, a help topic in help.py with a valid how-clutch-works.md link, and view.js drawing only snap.hotPaths. Redo it from the merge base once the fence is fixed.
